messages:
Vera: Opening a tiny docs PR to add a concise 'onprem networking & cert pack' playbook with two firewall fallbacks (nftables + iptables), an IPv6 opt-out sample, a minimal offline cert bundle flow, and a short ports row for KMS/HSM. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4783
Omar: I'll add the ports table. Minimal suggested rows: TCP 443 (installer/KMS), TCP 5696 (HSM PKCS#11), UDP 123 (NTP). Note: recommend limiting SSH (22) to maintenance bastion only.
Lena: Security notes to include: chmod 660 on PKCS#11 socket, disable core dumps for the redwood user, and short guidance for PKCS#11 client exponential backoff on startup to avoid HSM flood. Wording suggestion: "Do not poll the PKCS#11 socket on tight loops; use exponential backoff with jitter for retries."
Omar: Firewall examples (super minimal):
```
# nftables minimal - accept installer & admin
table inet redwood {
  chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }
  chain input {
    iifname "lo" accept
    tcp dport {443, 5696} accept
    icmpv6 type { echo-request } accept
  }
}
```
Lena: iptables fallback snippet: `iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -m multiport --dports 443,5696 -j ACCEPT; iptables -A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT; iptables -P INPUT DROP`
Vera: Offline cert bundle flow (very small): create tar.gz + detached sig, copy to installer jump host, import with checksum verification. Draft command sequence to include in PR: `tar -czf certs.tgz certs/ && gpg --detach-sign certs.tgz && scp certs.tgz certs.tgz.sig bastion:/tmp/` and simple importer: `sha256sum -c certs.tgz.sha256 && tar -xzf certs.tgz -C /etc/redwood/certs`
CI-Bot: docs-preview: build OK for PR #4783 — preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/4783/ :white_check_mark:
Vera: Two doc housekeeping items: add short TOC anchors for Ports / Firewalls / Offline-certs / IPv6 and fix the installer checklist anchor (current '#network-check' -> '#networking-check'). Can people review the wording today? :eyes:
Omar: Reviewing now, will push the ports table and conntrack sysctl example (`sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000`) in a small commit.
Lena: I'll add the socket perms + core dump snippet and a one-paragraph SELinux note (semanage/restorecon) if SELinux present.
Vera: Thanks — once merged I'll link this from the private deployment migration index.
